info.title: PlaybookControlPlaneService
info.description: On-prem administrative API for Playbook provisioning and policy.

get.description: Lists models supported by this deployment. On-prem returns the configured embedding allowlist; cloud may also advertise extraction models.

Lists the account's Playbooks. Cloud requests require JSESSIONID and X-CSRF-Token in addition to the operator JWT. If a selected database is unavailable, its Playbook remains listed without endpoint, database name or accessCidrs enrichment.

post.description: Creates and provisions one Playbook. A deployment-configured per-tenant limit applies; the on-prem default is 128. Cloud requests require JSESSIONID and X-CSRF-Token in addition to the operator JWT.

get.description: Reads one Playbook. Cloud requests require JSESSIONID and X-CSRF-Token in addition to the operator JWT.

patch.description: Updates mutable Playbook settings. Cloud requests require JSESSIONID and X-CSRF-Token in addition to the operator JWT.

post.description: Administratively clears all (default), entries, or proposals from a ready Playbook, preserving configuration and index readiness. Requires product_admin or suite_admin. Cleanup is not atomic across content: failures can leave partial progress; retry the same scope after resolving the failure. Without new writes, repeating a successful clear removes no additional entry families.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Content to clear. Omission clears all entries and proposals while preserving the Playbook.

post.description: Registers a client-supplied RAM store reference and FAQ policy. Returns preparing and enabled=false. The control plane asynchronously provisions extraction-worker RAM source read and Playbook destination read/propose grants; both accepted grants make the binding ready, refused grants make it blocked, and dependency outages remain pending for retry. The worker validates live RAM access when extraction runs. Poll GET until ready, then PATCH to enable.

patch.description: Updates FAQ policy or activation using expectedVersion. Supply job or enabled. Enabling requires ready status; pause is allowed while extraction is disabled. The deployment gate blocks policy updates and activation. Source identity is immutable; create a replacement binding to change stores. Stale revisions return conflict.

get.description: Returns tenant-scoped deployment-configured store suggestions, which may be empty. A client may submit another syntactically valid storeId. No RAM call or approval check occurs.

CreateExtractionBindingResponseContent.description: Durable tenant-owned metadata for one Playbook, one RAM store, and one FAQ policy. Ready means the configured extraction-worker grants were accepted; the worker validates live RAM access during execution. Without a configured RAM connection, preparation remains pending and cannot be enabled. This release has no extraction worker. Activation requires a separate PATCH after readiness.

enabled.description: Activation intent. Creation is disabled; enabling requires ready status and a separate PATCH. Pausing clears intent and retains prepared source/destination grants.

version.description: Optimistic configuration revision, independent of schedules and job runs.

blockedReason.description: Machine-readable source preparation or execution failure reason, such as source_grant_refused, source_not_found, or source_access_denied. Clients must tolerate unknown reasons.

maxPreviewTokens.description: Optional estimated discovery-preview token ceiling. Missing or null on create disables budgeting; PATCH omission preserves the value and null clears it. Estimates use o200k_base over compact preview JSON plus fixed allowances, stored at authoring. The ceiling covers one logical discovery payload; model framing, session history and subsequent content loads are excluded.

ExtractionBindingSource.description: Typed RAM store reference. This release accepts only redis_agent_memory and a client-supplied storeId. The source is implicitly whole-store. When the deployment enables the RAM connection, server-side preparation verifies store access. Namespace selection and extraction workers arrive later; credentials are never accepted here. Unknown fields are rejected.

ExtractionConflictErrorResponseContent.description: Binding version/state conflict, or extraction disabled by deployment configuration. Disabled extraction still permits inspection, pause and deletion.

intervalSeconds.description: Read-only platform scan cadence, fixed at 300 seconds.

ExtractionJobConfiguration.description: One extraction kind and its user-owned policy. Scan cadence is fixed at 300 seconds and is not accepted in requests. Omitted idleWindowSeconds defaults to 1800 on create and retains its existing value on update. Idle bounds are 60–86400 seconds. Model context and output budgets are deployment-owned worker settings rather than binding fields. Job type is immutable; changing extraction kind requires a new binding. Policy changes advance the binding version and do not reset completed-source deduplication.

ExtractionJobType.description: Exactly one extraction job kind. Skill extraction is reserved for future implementation and is currently rejected.

storeId.description: Optional deployment-configured suggestion; not an approval or verification of this store.
